sections.heading: Public goods and externalities in Public Finance and Taxation
paragraphs: Public goods and externalities is studied here as a specific part of Public Finance and Taxation. Begin by defining the term precisely and identifying the problem it helps explain or solve. Keep the scope narrow: related ideas may interact with it, but they are not interchangeable.

Economics studies choices under scarcity and how incentives shape allocation.
